60 Minutes on Instagram: "Artemis II, once slated for 2024, is now set to launch today. The mission will send four astronauts on a 1.4-million-mile flyby of the moon.

In 2024, NASA’s then-Acting Inspector General George Scott told 60 Minutes each launch costs an estimated $4.2 billion."
